## Proposal

Describe the proposed feature, research direction, experiment, or documentation improvement.

## Purpose

What problem would this solve or what question would it help answer?

## Proposed approach

Describe how you think the work could be carried out.

## Expected value

What useful result could this produce?

Examples:

- improved reproducibility;
- safer recovery;
- additional D3313 comparison data;
- better firmware analysis;
- automation;
- privacy improvement;
- documentation improvement.

## Risks

Does the proposal involve:

- firmware writes;
- EEPROM or eFuse programming;
- soldering or rework;
- irreversible operations;
- sensitive data;
- third-party proprietary material?

If yes, describe how the risk can be minimized.

## Related work

Link to relevant issues, documentation, prior research, manufacturer sources, or external projects.

## Additional notes

Add any other relevant information.
